method: Codex viewed all three original PNG files using view_image
scope: Third-star presence and observed screenshot composition only; not full UI/device acceptance

captures.observation: Phone overview shows all three suns inside the four-world system, with the triple-system caption and existing UI controls. The native Follow achievement toast remains present.

Phone Reduced Motion plus Effects Off close-up visibly retains the orange third-star glow. The textured primary is partly offscreen due to the deliberate camera framing; this does not establish companion close-up surface detail.

Desktop close-up visibly retains the centered orange third-star glow, readable caption and separate commands. Primary is partly offscreen by deliberate framing. Companion granulated surfaces remain a visible unfinished gap.
